property_summary: For any caller and any address argument, the original contract C allows SetLogFile(...) to succeed only before Initialized() is called; the mutant allows SetLogFile(...) to succeed only after Initialized(), so there exist inputs (an address and initialization state) that make their outcomes differ — specifically, SetLogFile should be callable before initialization and revert after, while the mutant flips this behavior.
change_summary: Replace the initializer check to allow setting Log even after initialized by negating the condition (removes revert when initialized).
